name: Pepperidge Farm Goldfish Original / Cheddar Crackers
whyItWorks: Small, bite-sized baked wheat crackers with a tender, hollow structure that breaks down rapidly in saliva. Low in fat and fiber, providing gentle carbs and sodium.
prepOrOrderInstructions: A great pocket snack during long drives, flare days, or errands when blood sugar drops.
watchOuts: Chew small handfuls thoroughly before swallowing.
